instruction.text: Naim erzählt von einem typischen Tag im Internat. Lies dir die Textabschnitte durch und tippe die jeweils passende Überschrift an.

atoms.a: I wake up at 7 am every day. I brush my teeth, put my clothes on, and then I go to breakfast with my roommate. Our houseparent checks on us at half past seven to make sure that we don't oversleep. After breakfast, we return to our rooms to get our backpacks for school. And then we go to class.

Every day, we have seven lessons that are each 45 minutes long. In between we have five-minute breaks, but also a 50-minute lunch break once a day. Sometimes we have tests. Today, I got an A in information technology.

At 4 p.m. our extracurricular activities start. On Mondays, I have football. On Wednesdays, there is my band practice. And on Fridays, my photography club takes place. My favourite club is football, because it is fun to play with my teammates. Next week, we have a football match. I'm already excited and confident that we will win.

After our extracurricular activities, I usually go back to my room and do my homework or study for tests. Then I spend some more time with friends. Most of the time, we watch films, play video games or spend time in the communal rooms. At 9 p.m. we have to be in our rooms, but we can do quiet activities, like reading a book. At 10 p.m. we have to go to bed.
